(zzzzzz) sorry. what was the question
aboutMore: the real thing about the sleep: my dad is a baker (sunrise bakery, opens at 6). he gets up at 4:10 and every morning he walks past the back office and my face is on the keyboard. he puts a blanket on me. at 5:45 he leaves a warm roll on the desk. i never wake up for either. the keyboard leaves a line on my cheek, m n and the space bar in a row. my mom says its a map. in the morning the blanket is on me and my character is still in henesys. we both slept.
meet: Who I'd like to meet: whoever designed the henesys fountain (best place to sleep in any game). a boss that lets u nap between phases. anyone who hit level 50 without falling asleep (how). a ribbon pig, in person. and my dads dough, before it rises. he says dough has feelings. i think he is not wrong.

interests.Movies: kiki's delivery service (the bakery lady is my moms idol), my neighbor totoro (the cat bus is the best nap), spirited away (the bathhouse is basically a free market room), sleeping beauty (relatable), finding nemo (ryans, i watched it for him)
interests.Television: avatar (the sleeping bison), spongebob (the nap episodes), pokemon (snorlax: my guy, i would also block a road), anything with a couch in it
interests.Books: my dads cookbook (his margin notes say 'more butter' 11 times, his handwriting is the best handwriting), charlotte's web (the barn at night is perfect), the phantom tollbooth (the doldrums chapter is a perfect description of 3 pm), the maplestory comics from the book fair (they are just screenshots)
interests.Heroes: my dad (the baker, up at 4:10 for 22 years), my grandma (calls me wilhelmina, i answer), snorlax, the person who made the free market (a place where u can just sit and sell and its fine to just sit), usagi (says my sleeping is a 'power-up arc,' i dont know what that is, i like it), ryan (his sentence about free is my best seller)

blog.title: how to sleep in henesys (a guide) (i am qualified)
blog.body: step 1. pick a town. henesys. the fountain is the best seat. step 2. dont pick the dead mine. the dead mine is not a bed. i have learned this 11 times. step 3. sit with your back to a wall (a pixel wall). step 4. stop pressing keys. step 5. let your face find the keyboard. this takes about 4 seconds. step 6. wake up. step 7. check if you sold anything. i sold a mushroom. i dont know how. step 8. check your exp. it hasnt changed. its a tide. step 9. repeat. step 10. when u wake up someone has put a blanket on u. this is not in the game. this is real life. it is the best part. i recommend it. i recommend having a dad.

blog.title: my dads cookbook (the margin notes)
blog.body: my dad has a cookbook he has had for 22 years. the bakery is built on it. he never writes a recipe down. he just writes in the margins. 'more butter' (11 times). 'not enough salt, again.' 'ask mom.' 'dont rush the proof.' on the page for plain rolls it says 'these are for Min' in pencil with a little drawing of a roll with a face. i found it when i was 9 and i didnt say anything. now every time he leaves a warm roll on the desk at 5:45 i think about the face on the page. i never wake up for it. but i know he was there. i can smell it. the keyboard smells like bread. i have decided thats what a good morning is.

blog.title: the exp bar is a tide (a theory)
blog.body: i have been level 70-ish for 41 days. i have a theory. every night i grind from 8 pm to about 3:54 am. i gain 9% a night. then i fall asleep (usually in the dead mine, which is a mistake) and the monsters take about 8% back. i net 1%. sometimes minus. the exp bar is not a ladder. its a tide. it comes in, it goes out, and every so often it leaves a shell on the beach. the shell is a level. i have found the same shell 11 times. my dad says its a metaphor. i said for what. he said 'baking.' i said bread doesnt go backward. he said 'no. but it falls if u open the oven.' i have opened the oven 11 times. i dont know. im tired.
